## Failing symbol

`org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.ng.filter.StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter`
imported at `extensions/struts2/test/com/google/inject/struts2/Struts2FactoryTest.java:19`

```
[ERROR] /guice/extensions/struts2/test/com/google/inject/struts2/Struts2FactoryTest.java:[19,46]
  error: package org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.ng.filter does not exist
```

The class was moved in struts2-core 2.5.x:

| Version | FQCN |
|---------|------|
| 2.3.37 (old) | `org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.ng.filter.StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter` |
| 2.5.22 (new) | `org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.filter.StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter` |

`uptake_api_lookup` confirms the old package (`ng.filter`) is entirely absent from the new jar;
the new class is available at `struts2-core-2.5.22.jar`.

## Fix required

A compatibility shim must be created in the **production source root** of the module:

```
extensions/struts2/src/org/apache/struts2/dispatcher/ng/filter/StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter.java
```

Content:
```java
package org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.ng.filter;

/**
 * Compatibility shim: struts2-core 2.5.x moved this class to
 * org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.filter. Extends the new location
 * so existing import statements continue to compile.
 */
public class StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter
    extends org.apache.struts2.dispatcher.filter.StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter {}
```

## Why this is an escalation

This project uses a non-standard Maven source layout: `<sourceDirectory>${project.basedir}/src</sourceDirectory>`
(declared in the root `pom.xml` at line 190). The production sources live under `src/` directly
(e.g. `extensions/struts2/src/com/google/inject/struts2/`), **not** under `src/main/java/`.

The repair tool's write permission is restricted to `src/main/java/` paths, so the new file
cannot be created without a human placing it at the path shown above.

## Human decision required

A human must create the file `extensions/struts2/src/org/apache/struts2/dispatcher/ng/filter/StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter.java`
with the content shown above. No build-file change is needed — the existing `<sourceDirectory>` already
covers the `src/` tree.
